verdict.rationale: DBOS checkpoints the outcome of every step, and those checkpoints can be reviewed to find a failure's cause and audit each step. The Conductor console is documented for monitoring and observing workflows, restarting from a specific step, and searching workflows. However, the evidence never explicitly describes a per-run step timeline in the dashboard showing inputs, outputs, retries and errors, nor filtering. missing for 10: documented dashboard step-timeline view with per-step inputs/outputs, per-step retry visibility, explicit filter capabilities, independent hands-on corroboration of the UI.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every run has a step-by-step timeline — inputs, outputs, retries, and errors per step — in a dashboard my team can search and filter

citations.quote: Because workflows checkpoint the outcome of each step of your workflow, you can review these checkpoints to see the cause of the failure and audit every step that led to it.
Monitor, version, fork, replay, and observe durable workflows with DBOS Conductor console.
From the Conductor dashboard, you can pause any workflow execution, start any stopped or enqueued workflow, or restart any workflow from a specific step.
